any.description: Delete messages in this channel up to a message, or the latest few

untilLinkOption.description: Link of the message to keep; everything newer than it is deleted

fromLinkOption.description: Link of the message to start from, included. Default: the newest

countOption.description: Instead of a link, delete this many of the latest messages

needsUntilOrCount: Give until-link, or count to delete the latest messages.
untilAndCountConflict: Use either until-link or count, not both.
fromWithCount: from-link works together with until-link only; leave it out when you use count.
wrongChannel: The messages must be in the channel where you run this command.
UNTIL_NOT_FOUND: I could not find the until message in this channel.
FROM_NOT_FOUND: I could not find the from message in this channel.
RANGE_REVERSED: The until message must be older than the from message.
RANGE_TOO_LARGE: That covers more than {max} messages. Pick a closer message and try again.

confirm.promptRange: Delete {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} newer than the until message (which stays)? This cannot be undone.
confirm.promptLast: Delete the latest {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}? This cannot be undone.
confirm.olderNote: {older, plural, one {# of them is} other {# of them are}} older than 14 days and will be deleted one by one, which takes longer.
confirm.expired: No answer in time. Nothing was deleted.

done: Deleted {deleted, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}.
